subject: Appointment of a puisne Judge of the Court of Appeal of Quebec
precis: Appointment of the Honourable Audrey Boctor, a Judge of the Superior Court of Quebec for the district of Montréal, to be a puisne Judge of the Court of Appeal of Quebec, with residence in the territory of Ville de Montréal or in the immediate vicinity thereof.
